social_media.headline: G3–G4 Geomagnetic Storm Conditions Expected
social_media.summary: Significant geomagnetic storm conditions are expected worldwide and in Earth's orbit. Higher-latitude regions face the greatest potential impacts.

confidence.label: Chance of G3+
confidence.detail: This includes a 5% chance of G5 conditions through early Monday.

what_we_know: There is a 65% chance of storm onset between 1800 UTC Friday and 0000 UTC Saturday.
Possible onset ranges from 1200 UTC Friday to 0600 UTC Saturday.
Storm conditions may last 24 to 48 hours.
Additional CME influences may renew activity through early Monday.

footer.left: Next update by 0030 UTC Saturday, or sooner if conditions change.
footer.center: Prepare now and follow sector-specific procedures.

visual.alt_text: Forecast visualization for expected G3–G4 and possible G5 geomagnetic storm conditions.
